title: Benchmark fidelity and cost: the router reads on Haiku 5.5, Opus runs on its subset, the reviewer at effort low
goal: The pool benchmark's router-pinned arm reads on the model the haiku alias resolves to (claude-haiku-5-5) and its router rows are re-recorded on it, with the report, token-efficiency.md and design.md stating the reader's model and the re-recorded cost; a default pool record runs Opus 5.5 on its sanity subset and the full Opus arm only when named, so the record command plans about 20 Opus runs instead of 300; kb-reviewer runs at effort low when the host-lookups kb-review-workspace cell still names all five planted problems at low, with design.md stating that lookups and reviews run at effort low.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
